steps: Echo of Hearts and Stars (Part II)
Caramel asks you to be her producer. What will you do to reignite her spark?
Even the sweet scent in the dessert shop here is stronger than anywhere else. Guess that's Flavio for you.
She looks famished...==W== That's a mighty appetite, Caramel!
There were so many fans at your show just now. You should be making some decent money.
So why are you still starving?
… Sometimes it just slips my mind...
Oh... You get so caught up in the performance that you forget to eat, huh…
I mean, I forget to put the money jar out...
I guess that's a part of being a genius.
Ah! It's not like that happens all the time! I do get paid for performances!==W== The music space owners usually remind me!
But maintaining the bass, buying sheet music, and tickets for performances... It all adds up.
Then there's travel costs... Plus supplies for exploring the Monoliths...
Is it any wonder that I can't afford to eat?
No matter how much music can nourish your soul, it won't fill your stomach.
It's one thing in the city,==W== but you do realize that if you collapse from hunger in the wilds or the Monolith, there's no one around to save you?
Hehe... That's why having a producer is so important!
Watching her happily stuff her face with crepe,==W== my mind eases for a bit.
With the hunger taken care of, Caramel and I stroll down the street—==W==it's time to take on the responsibilities of being her producer.
Ah... That was so tasty. I haven't had so much delicious food in a long time...
You need to take care of your health...
But let's get back to business.==W== How did you usually find your creative inspiration before?
Let me see...==W== Ohhh, I know, watching "performances."
Oops, sorry, should have made myself clear.==W== I mean "performances" by Mother Nature!
Oh... So basically "listening to the sounds of the mountains, the sea, the Monoliths, and the sky"? Something like that?
Once you get used to it, you start to realize that Caramel sees the world a little differently. As her producer, you really have got to pay attention.
Yes, all those are performances put on by Mother Nature...
Just listening to those distant, echoing sounds==W== is enough to bring me to tears.==W== And then, the inspiration just flows on its own...
This type of art might be a bit too avant-garde for Novians.
… You aren't laughing at me, are you?
After all... In the face of nature, even the mighty Boss can feel small and powerless...
In terms of that feeling of being in awe, we're really not that different. It's just that you choose to embrace it while I choose to push back.
I love that! It's got such a great rhythm! Can I turn it into lyrics?
Actually, I've been watching performances in Flavio, too...==W== Even though the tickets add up.
You can't draw inspiration from them any more?
How do I put it...==W== Back then, there were a lot of great performances. They always opened my mind up... I could see the musicians' inner landscape.
But lately those performances are getting few and far in between.
After a long silence, she lets out a deep breath, and explains—
I'm not great with words, but... There are some pieces... No matter how popular they are—I just can't connect with them.
Sometimes I wonder if I've just been out of touch with what people like for too long...==W== But I really can't bring myself to play just for the sake of getting attention.
Music's supposed to express things—your feelings, your stories, right?==W== If it's just about drawing a crowd with loud noise, without painting any inner landscape…
Well, that kind of music has its place too.==W== But when I play alongside them, it feels like I'm not expressing anything at all.
Maybe I'm not good enough...==W== But no matter what, I... I just can't listen to it, and I don't really understand it.
Your words are gentle. The underlying message, not so much.
Huh? W-wait, no! That's not what I meant!
I really believe everyone in Flavio is chasing something meaningful in their own way... We're just going about it differently, that's all.
I see... So, for Caramel, this is a bit of a blind spot.
I ignore her polite attempt to smooth things over and try to steer her thoughts back on track—
—Like you said, music is meant for expression.
Playing for the ocean or the stars—that's beautiful, and it really feels like you.
But honestly, they're not the only ones who truly hear you. ==W==I mean the people in the city—the ones gathered in front of your stage, your fans.
I know, but every time there are that many people, I just...
She puffs out her cheeks and gives me a few light punches—==W==wow, those are a musician's hands alright, strong and solid.
I can't get used to it... I feel so useless...
You feel like you can't see into their hearts?
I really don't know how to communicate with people except through music...
They're different from the ocean and the mountains...==W== They cheer, they call out to me. But I...
What should I say in response...?
If today's performance didn't quite click with the crowd... Do I need to explain myself somehow?
I don't know... It's so hard to think about all this.
All I know is music... Everything outside of that just feels so complicated!
Only a very very small number of people are like you—==W==someone who gets the bass, my music, and what I'm trying to express.
I used to feel really lost... Unsure of everything. But with you as my producer...==W== I feel like I finally have the courage to face it all.
Yeah! Actually, Producer, what you said really makes a lot of sense.
She clenches her fists like she's made up her mind about something. Her long ears perk up as well.
I... I can give it a try. What should I do? Set up a performance right away?
Once she's made up her mind, she starts acting fast. Classic Caramel.
A producer's job is to help the musician find their spark, right?
Then... My theme this time will be "healing mental scars."
Yeah, the reason I've been visiting Flavio is that I need to complete a really important commission.
There's a group of Trekkers who had an accident during a Monolith expedition...==W== As a result, a lot of them are on the verge of mental breakdown.
And this might be your chance to understand their wishes and hear their true feelings.==W== I can’t promise anything, but maybe… it’ll spark something new.
Even as the Boss, I can't possibly grasp what so many people are feeling...==W== But Caramel, you're different.
Me...? I'm just a bass player...
Your music reaches the mountains, the ocean, even the Monoliths.==W== So I believe those who are hurting will hear you, too.
I see... Let me think about this... Really think about this...
Since we're aiming for the same goal, let's start the preparation.
Leave the rest of the details to me, your producer. Caramel, all you need to focus on is the music.
… Thank you for the idea, Producer. I never thought this journey for inspiration would get started so smoothly.
So this is what it feels like … to write music for someone else...
